market.why: Stock indices saw declines, influenced by rising oil prices attributed to increased tensions involving Iran and the potential impact of Hurricane Isaias on U.S. Gulf production.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield edged up slightly as traders processed comments from a Federal Reserve official and considered the outcomes of recent bond auctions, with broader concerns about inflation and geopolitical developments also influencing bond yields.

vix.why: The articles do not provide a specific reason for the minimal increase in the VIX.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased in the most recent weekly survey, reflecting the upward trend in 10-year Treasury yields observed in recent days, influenced by factors such as inflation and geopolitical concerns.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This document contains proposed regulations regarding employer contributions to Trump accounts and nondiscrimination rules for dependent care assistance programs.
policy_week.effect: Employer contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance and nondiscrimination rules.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations provide general requirements for Trump accounts, their establishment, and qualified general contributions.
policy_week.effect: You would be affected by new requirements for establishing Trump accounts and making qualified contributions to them.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

world.summary: A Russian strike on two civilian buses in Ukraine's Donetsk region resulted in the deaths of at least 33 people.
